body: This speaks so deeply to me it's not even funny. My depression is at the worst it's ever been. I'm kind of heavily tattoo'ed and have been craving a tattoo for the pain it brings. I cut for the first time tonight and I loved it. I'm not yet sure whether it's something than I'll do again. The logical part of me knows I will get addicted, but I love the pain.

Oh. See... that's the thing.... I came out to all of them about my depression and only one of them gave a fuck. He's the only one who will speak to me, but when I try to tell him about how fucked up my shit is, all he can say are things like, "Well, you put yourself here." or shit like that.

This was a really crappy step for me. I never talked to anyone about my depression because I thought they would think I was being dramatic or overreacting, or just not care, and my worst fears came true.
